MP3 (MPEG-1/2/2.5 Layers 1-3) demuxer (MpaReader).

Ports symphonia-bundle-mp3 demuxer/header: byte-wise frame resync with strict next-frame similarity gate, Xing/Info (incl. LAME delay/padding, CRC-16-ANSI-LE checked) and VBRI duration headers, CBR fallback estimation, per-packet PTS/duration with gapless trims derived from the valid-frame window, and binary-search seek with bit-reservoir (main_data_begin) backtrack. Deviations: in-memory with an eager packet index; ID3v2/v1/Lyrics tags are skipped as junk by resync (as in the reference, which has no explicit ID3 parsing here).
